```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown";
function main() {
  const result = convert("<html><head><title>Article</title><script type=\"application/ld+json\">{\"@context\":\"https://schema.org\",\"@type\":\"Article\",\"headline\":\"My Article\",\"author\":{\"@type\":\"Person\",\"name\":\"Jane Doe\"},\"datePublished\":\"2024-01-15\"}</script></head><body><h1>My Article</h1><p>Article body text.</p></body></html>");
  console.log(result);
}
```
